hotspots.title: Trump Midterm Rallies & Campaign Trail Violence
hotspots.blurb: President Trump is executing a high-velocity campaign blitz across key midterm battlegrounds, including Florida and Iowa, urging voters to turn out to stave off political 'darkness.' His rallies and high-profile early voting appearances in West Palm Beach are driving intensive coverage focused on mobilizing the MAGA base and stoking partisan urgency.
hotspots.affect: Commands maximum attention through high-stakes electoral rhetoric, existential framing, and heavy cross-source media focus.

hotspots.title: Midterm Election Legal Battles & Voter Roll Controversies
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration has launched aggressive legal actions targeting election administration, including Justice Department lawsuits seeking to block Senate race certification in Alaska and federal demands to audit California voter rolls. Civil rights advocates and state officials accuse the administration of voter intimidation and disenfranchisement, while conservative voices frame the moves as essential safeguards against illegal noncitizen voting.
hotspots.affect: Drives fierce partisan dispute over voting rights, election integrity, and executive overreach on the eve of the midterms.

hotspots.title: Trump Escalation of Iran War & Military Threats
hotspots.blurb: Escalating U.S. military action against Iran has ignited economic shockwaves, sending crude oil prices surging to $114 a barrel and stoking fears of rate hikes. The conflict has drawn harsh rebukes from former President Obama and sparked further alarm as Trump hints at military posturing toward Cuba and intelligence reports warn of Iranian plotting against U.S. personnel.
hotspots.affect: Generates widespread economic anxiety and sharp partisan conflict over national security and military intervention.

hotspots.title: Trump Attacks LeBron James & NFL Over Anthem
hotspots.blurb: Trump reignited prominent culture war feuds by publicly denouncing NBA superstar LeBron James for moving during the national anthem and demanding the NFL postpone its international game in Paris due to local civil unrest. Right-wing media personalities rallied to defend Trump's rhetoric, while critics condemned the statements as divisive identity politics.
hotspots.affect: Elicits strong emotional investment by channeling patriotic grievance and sports-focused political outrage.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen kicked off her French presidential campaign with a message of national optimism and renewal, mobilizing party strategists ahead of the Rassemblement National congress in Orléans. The launch focuses on consolidating right-wing support in France amid broader political and economic instability.
hotspots.affect: Commands attention within French right-wing discourse through political campaign mobilization and leadership messaging.
